text:
Maria: Heads-up — AcmeEval (trial account) is hitting repeated 5xxs when they send bursty batched requests (~300 rps). Started ~10:12PT. Sales flagged the demo and CISO wants logs. Can SRE triage? cc @priya

deploy-bot: autoscale event: added 2 nodes to eval-pool at 10:13:22

Priya: On it. Can you paste a couple request IDs or a minimal failing payload? Also which model?

Maria: Model: r-instruct-large-v1 (hosted). Mostly 502/503. Example request id: 0a9f7c3b. Payloads are small, single-turn textgen.

Jake: I'm oncall, pulling last 30m traces from frontdoor and routing tables. Gimme 2.

Sean: Observed queue depth spike -> backlog -> grpc error 14 on worker side, frontdoor converting to 503. Autoscale did kick but backlog didn't drain quickly. Looks like cold starts on new instances (quantized kernel warmup is expensive).

Anita: Short-term mitigations: enable a warm pool for this customer OR route them to a lower-memory quant variant. Immediate quick win: set batch_size=1 for their tenant to reduce tail latency.

Priya: Sales asks price impact for enabling warm pool for the trial — rough estimate?

Sean: Warm pool = reserved warm instances. For 2 warm GPUs ballpark is ~$450/month; for demo we can timebox to hours and prorate. I'll get precise calc.

Maria: CISO is asking for an audit bundle showing requests + traces for compliance. Do we have a prepared export?

Jake: I triggered diagnostics and uploaded bundle: https://redwood-internal/diag/2618004321 — includes frontdoor traces, instance syslogs, and model loading timestamps. No OOMs surfaced.

deploy-bot: incident note: autoscale-latency observed = 120s (policy: scale_by_util, cooldown 60s)

Anita: Can we try switching the scale policy to queue-based / aggressive for this eval cluster? That should reduce tail and trigger earlier scale-ups.

Sean: I can flip policy for 30m window. Doing it now. @deploy-bot apply: eval-pool-7 scale_policy=aggressive duration=30m

deploy-bot: command accepted — policy updated for eval-pool-7

Maria: Thanks. Sales needs stability for a live demo tomorrow 11:00PT. Can we guarantee no 5xxs in the next 24h?

Priya: If we combine warm pool + aggressive scaling + a fallback routing to a smaller quantized model on overload, risk should be low. I'll draft the config + costs and send to sales now.

Jake: Also pushing a client-side recommendation: retries (2) with jitter, small backoff. Snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{ "model":"r-instruct-large-v1", "max_tokens":256, "batch_size":1 }'
```

Priya: I will also attach a short security note about logs retention and where the diagnostic bundle lives, and loop in legal if CISO wants retention SLA.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll update Acme and ask them to hold the scheduled demo by 1 hour if we need to. Appreciate the fast triage team.

Sean: Keeping an eye on queue depth and scale actions. Will post another update in ~10m.

Jake: +1, monitoring frontdoor error rate and instance readiness.

Priya: Sending pricing + config now.

Maria: Closing the loop after sales confirms. Thanks everyone!
